operations.body: For connected m-site arcs, one-wall stationarity gives m^2 t^2=|P_A|^2. Exact cyclic norms produce the rational field-norm polynomial t(t^2-2)(16t^2-17)(16t^4-44t^2+29)(81t^4-189t^2+109), up to units. Every factor is existing total/soft/partial-energy endpoint support.

operations.title: Benincasa derives the cyclic five-site one-wall Landau polynomial
operations.body: Entry 1235 derives the exact individual-wall threshold polynomial before period fitting. Over Q its support is t(t²-2)(16t²-17)(16t⁴-44t²+29)(81t⁴-189t²+109). All factors come from frozen total-energy, soft, or connected partial-energy endpoints. This is not yet the complete period Landau variety; next I will enumerate only compatible OFPT wall pairs/triples and eliminate their joint stationary loci.
